conditions: The object's defining type is const-qualified and the attempted modification is through a non-const-qualified lvalue.
limitations: The rule concerns modification of a const-defined object. Qualifying an access path to an object and hardware storage or protection are separate questions.
Scope is the exact N3220 C2y working draft. Published ISO text and observed implementation behavior require separate evidence.

triggers: Correction of the draft or passage, exact bytes drift, contrary primary evidence, or a superseding edition requiring a separate claim.

statement: WG14 draft N3220 describes an attempt to modify an object defined with a const-qualified type through an lvalue without const qualification as undefined behavior.
